positions.description: Working on a contract basis as developer, designer and marketer for DeadPixel products.

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer across multiple stacks and production code bases:
- Wrapify - Android application written using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. 
   --> https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wrapify.drive&hl=en_US&gl=US
- Wrapify - iOS application written using Swift and SwiftUI
   --> https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wrapify/id966952238
- Serverless services including API layer lambdas, events, streams and other AWS tools written in Golang
- Storage layers like Dynamo, S3 and RDS mysql database hosted in Amazon.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lots and lots of swift!
Helped develop the GoSite Mobile app on iOS using UIKit
Grew the team, interviewing and onboarding to expand the dev team at GoSite

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lots of swift, some graphs, AWS, and even a bit of Angular	
    - Expanded skillset from mobile to include modern web (react, angular, node) as well as Graphs and Query Languages.
    - First steps into the wide world of cloud computing and modern architecture through AWS.
    - Velocity leader in Agile teams with a focus on mentoring younger developers, enforcing good coding standards, and architecture leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Worked with large national clients helping develop internal tools for major utilities companies.
